findings.message: Positioned element renders far outside its offset parent — its coordinates were likely computed in a different frame (canvas/viewport pixels).
findings.fixHint: Compute left/top in the offset parent's frame (subtract its rect), or mark intentional placement with data-layout-allow-overflow.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 4 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Record the screen." at 16 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
